messages.author: 470a59fea9e139e0
messages.subject: Using httr with oauth2.0
parts:
Does anyone know the httr package? I am trying to access the Canvas API and have a valid oauth2.0 token. I am trying to use a basic GET()request.

Does anyone have experience with httr? How do I use it with oauth2.0 authentication by supplying my token?

# Set UP
url = "https://canvas.ucdavis.edu/api/v1/courses"
key = "secret_key"

# Attempts
GET(url, sign_oauth2.0(key)) #  Error: Deprecated: supply token object to config directly
GET(url, config(sign_oauth2.0 = key)) # unknown option: sign_oauth2.0
GET(url, config = list(sign_oauth2.0 = key)) # Status 401

messages.author: d567d0ef3c054a35
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Using httr with oauth2.0
parts:
I've made some use of httr, and I've been frustrated by the apparent
lack of end-to-end examples. I would have tried your last GET
attempt, possibly with some variation on the "sign_oauth2.0" thing.

I suspect that the authorization stuff is now in a separate function
or functions. I note that if you do:

> library(httr)
> ls(2)

you find no fewer than 15 objects with "oauth" in the name. Here's a
note from the master himself that may shed some light onto your
problem:

https://github.com/r-lib/httr/blob/master/demo/oauth2-google.r

-- Mike
